items: 🖥【1.57" HD AMOLED Touchscreen & 200+ Watch Faces】 This women's smartwatch features 1.57-inch HD AMOLED touchscreen (360x360 resolution),Even in bright sunlight outdoors, the AMOLED screen suppresses glare, making it easier to read the watch's contents. Choose from over 200 preloaded watch faces, or personalize it by uploading your favorite photos to make a unique style statement that is truly your own.

❤【Your 24/7 Health Watch & Wellness Companion】 Keep a pulse on your well-being. The Woneligo Health watch features advanced sensors to continuously track your heart rate, blood oxygen,stress levels, and sleep quality, with the added benefit of menstrual cycle tracking. Empower yourself with deeper insights to navigate your day with confidence.(note: All data is for general wellness and fitness purposes only and is not intended for medical use.)

📞【Smart Notifications & 7-Day Battery Life - Always Connected】 Keep your phone in your pocket. With Bluetooth 5.3, you’ll receive real-time alerts for texts, emails, and social media notifications directly on your wrist. so you never miss a beat, even when your hands are full.This smartwatch built-in DSP noise-reduction chip, you can make and receive crystal-clear calls directly from your wrist with minimal lag.Seamlessly pairs with iOS and Android phones.the watch also offers up to 7 days of use on just a 1.5-hour charge

🏃【120+ Sport Modes & IP68 Waterproof Fitness Watch】 This fitness watch Track your workouts accurately with 120+ sport modes, recording calories burned, distance, steps, and exercise duration. Rated IP68 waterproof, it withstands sweat, rain, and splashes—making it the perfect workout partner rain or shine.

🌟【Two Fashion Straps & 3Year Guarantee】 Switch up your style effortlessly with the included silicone and leather straps, ready for any occasion from the gym to a café. Your purchase is protected by a 3-year warranty and lifetime technical support, with our local team available around the clock to assist you.
